entries.title: Infinitary from your terminal
entries.body: The Infinitary Inbox in Settings, Integrations is now the Infinitary command. Run infinitary-axi in a terminal on this computer to see what waits on you, and to read your cards, tasks, crew, allowance, projects, Automation rules and knowledge. Run infinitary-axi setup to point your own AI agents at it. Notes from your scripts work as before, and the old name infinitary-inbox-axi still works.

picture.alt: The Infinitary command box in Settings, Integrations, turned on, with the command to copy, what to run and the setup line
